product_summary: Website groverfoods.com (accessed via http_get) presents the company exclusively as a POTATO FLAKES manufacturer/supplier/exporter: 'Potato Flakes Manufacturer & Exporter in India', 'Delivering Premium Potato Flakes to Global Food Brands & Businesses Since 1996', dehydrated potato flakes produced on Tummers (Netherlands) dehydration equipment, with 'Flakes Types' and 'Packaging Options' sub-pages. Plant address: 37/38-39, Vill. Naugawan, Faridpur, Bareilly - 243503, UP. No other product lines (no frozen foods, no ready-to-eat, no fruit/vegetable preserves) are listed anywhere on the site.
role_hint: manufacturer (own dehydration plant in Bareilly, UP; claims 25+ years in potato flakes, since 1996). No trader signs found - single-product industrial processor, not a multi-line trading house.
comment: HS mapping: the declared code 200410 (frozen prepared potatoes) does NOT match the actual product. Dehydrated potato flakes in commercial trade are classified under 2005.20 (potatoes prepared or preserved, not frozen - flour/meal/flakes of potatoes). Declared 200410 is therefore WRONG for the core line; correct code is 200520. Declared 071010 (fresh/chilled potatoes) is only plausible as a raw-material import/agri line - the site describes potato sourcing from Indian farms, not sale of fresh potatoes, so 071010 is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' as a sale line. Conversely, the declaration omits the company's actual main export line (200520 potato flakes) - a product line missing from the declaration. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly correct but imprecise: this is a B2B industrial ingredient/dehydrated-food processor, not an FMCG brand owner. Per Rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is kept, code corrected to 200520 (primary) with 071010 retained only as unconfirmed raw-material line. All product claims here are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line was available to me in this task (registry/customs volume research out of scope), so actual shipment factuality is not verified by this check. Note: site is a single-page app - /product and /about routes returned identical homepage content, so the 'Flakes Types' detail pages could not be read; no additional SKUs could be confirmed or excluded beyond potato flakes.
